investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Helwave Go (ride-hailing); Platform: AWS us-west-2 (zones us-west-2a/us-west-2b/us-west-2c/us-west-2d); network range 10.34.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster helwav-prod-uswest (EKS); Database: riders-db-01 holds riders records; Automation: data-retention workflows scheduled by Dagster and executed under service accounts (runs recorded with RUN- identifiers); Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
